title: D&D 5e Monster
description: A monster stat block. Extends Creature.

Creature.title: D&D 5e Creature
Creature.description: A creature in play, including player characters, NPCs, and monsters. Left open so Character and Monster may add fields.

custom_value.title: Custom Value
custom_value.description: A homebrew or otherwise non-canonical string value.

ability_scores.title: D&D 5e Ability Scores
ability_scores.description: The six ability scores of a creature.

hit_points.title: D&D 5e Hit Points
hit_points.description: The current hit point state of a creature in play.

hit_dice.title: D&D 5e Hit Dice
hit_dice.description: Hit dice used by a class definition or monster stat block.

custom_int.title: Custom Int
custom_int.description: A homebrew or otherwise non-canonical integer value.

movement.title: D&D 5e Movement
movement.description: A creature's speed for one movement type. Hover is a flag on fly speed.

movement_type.title: D&D 5e Movement Type
movement_type.description: A type of movement. Hover is a flag on fly speed, not its own type.

speed.title: D&D 5e Speed
speed.description: A distance and unit of movement.

distance_type.title: D&D 5e Distance Unit
distance_type.description: A unit used to describe a distance.

saving_throws.title: D&D 5e Saving Throw Modifiers
saving_throws.description: Saving throw modifiers for the six ability scores on a creature in play.

sense.title: D&D 5e Sense
sense.description: A special sense and its effective range.

condition.title: D&D 5e Condition
condition.description: A condition that can affect a creature.

feature.title: D&D 5e Feature
feature.description: A feature or trait granted by a class, subclass, race, background, feat, or other game element.

level.description: Class or subclass level at which this feature is gained.

source.title: Data Source
source.description: The source from which the data was obtained.

href.description: A URI linking to the source.

action.title: D&D 5e Action
action.description: An action a creature, race, class, or feat may use.

action_type.title: D&D 5e Action Type
action_type.description: The type of action used by a creature or feature.

target.title: D&D 5e Target
target.description: A target specification for an action or spell.

distance.title: D&D 5e Distance
distance.description: A distance value and its unit.

target_type.title: D&D 5e Target Type
target_type.description: The kind of creature or object that can be targeted.

target_count.title: D&D 5e Target Count
target_count.description: The number of targets an action or spell can affect.

target_zone.title: D&D 5e Target Zone
target_zone.description: The shape or scope of an action or spell's area.

effect.title: D&D 5e Effect
effect.description: An effect produced by an action, spell, feature, or attack.

roll.title: D&D 5e Roll with Modifier
roll.description: A dice roll with optional fixed and ability-based modifiers.

ability_score.title: D&D 5e Ability Score
ability_score.description: One of the six D&D 5e ability scores.

attack_hit.title: D&D 5e Attack Hit
attack_hit.description: An attack roll used to determine whether an attack hits.

attack_type.title: D&D 5e Attack Type
attack_type.description: The kind of attack roll made against a target.

attack_save.title: D&D 5e Saving Throw Effect
attack_save.description: A saving throw used to determine whether an effect affects a target.

grant.title: D&D 5e Grant
grant.description: A non-numeric characteristic granted by an item or effect.

spell_casting.title: D&D 5e Spellcasting
spell_casting.description: A creature's spellcasting abilities and spells.

spells_known.title: D&D 5e Spells Known
spells_known.description: The spells known or prepared by a creature and the spell slots available at each spell level.

roll_table.title: D&D 5e Roll Table
roll_table.description: A table of outcomes determined by a dice roll.

roll_table_entry.title: D&D 5e Roll Table Entry
roll_table_entry.description: An outcome corresponding to a roll result.

alt.description: Text to display if the image cannot load.

caption.description: Text to display below the image.
